ticket:
Title: Stops, export and sharing
Body: Add Stops to Day Plans, export an Itinerary as text, and let Travellers share a Trip with a Companion.

findings.message: Three independent behaviours: adding Stops (REQ-3), exporting (REQ-8), sharing. Split into three tickets.
findings.evidence: Add Stops to Day Plans, export an Itinerary as text, and let Travellers share

questions: Which one of the three should this ticket cover first?

Title: Limit Day Plans to 10 Stops
Body: Given a Day Plan with 10 Stops, When a Traveller adds another Stop, Then adding fails with a tooManyStops error.
